conventions.auth: Authorization: Bearer <credential>, from challenge then verify; your DID is your principal
conventions.heap: a route with `heap` also runs in your private heap at that href
conventions.links: _links: relation -> {href} or [{href, name}], on every JSON reply; relations are route names
conventions.actions: _actions on object, card and source replies: {name, method, href, fields: [{name, kind, bounds}], body, spell?, input?}, one per method of the host's method table a turn can run
conventions.typedData: {tag: natural|label|boolean, value} {tag: record, fields: [{name, value}]} {tag: list, items} {tag: variant, label, payload}
conventions.hashes: replies omit content ids except a receipt's own hash and a source's pin; ?full=1 shows them

envelope.more: a host's reply keeps its own fields (object, stage, module, span, diagnostic)

routes.does: this API in prose (text/plain); with Accept: application/json, this catalogue

routes.name: source

query.full: 1: the host's reply verbatim, content ids and all

routes.name: static

badRequest.when: the request line or a header is malformed, or Content-Length is not a number

badJson.when: the body is not a JSON object, or nests deeper than 256

badModules.when: `modules` is not a list of at most 16 objects

identity.when: a challenge or verification failed; `message` is the reason

hostRequest.when: the host refused the request as malformed; `message` (and a compile error's stage, module, span, hint) are the host's

unauthenticated.when: the credential is missing, unverified or revoked

denied.when: the host says you may not read it

unknown.when: the host knows nothing by that name that you may see

unknownRoute.when: no route here; the catalogue lists them

methodNotAllowed.when: the route takes another method; `Allow` names it

requestTimeout.when: the request did not arrive within 30 seconds

ambiguous.when: a slug names more than one receipt; cite it by CID

moduleTooLarge.when: a module sent is over 16384 bytes (the library is not sent)

uriTooLong.when: the request line is over 65536 bytes

rateLimited.when: over a rate limit; `Retry-After` says when to come back

headersTooLarge.when: a header line is over 65536 bytes, or there are over 100

internal.when: the front failed; nothing was decided

notImplemented.when: an HTTP method no route takes

replyTooLarge.when: the reply would be over 8388608 bytes; ask for less (compact, a page)

hostTimeout.when: hostd accepted the request and did not answer in time

httpVersion.when: the HTTP version is not 1.0 or 1.1

RecordNotFound.when: the host knows no such record

Denied.when: the host says you may not read it

AmbiguousSlug.when: the slug names more than one receipt: use the CID

HostTimeout.when: hostd did not answer in time

staleRoot.means: something the turn read moved before it committed

budget.means: the turn ran out of ticks, heap or bytes; `reason` names which

evaluation.means: the program refused or a Plan was malformed; `reason` says which

capacity.means: a host limit is full; `reason` or `object` names it

typeMismatch.means: the argument does not fit the method's input; `expected` shows the form

lawRefused.means: the object's law refused the change; `clause` names the law line

unknownObject.means: no such object, or not yours to see

programRefused.means: a reprogram's package: `clause` is packageBytes, compile, stateType, migration or law syntax

outOfRange.means: a list edit named an index past the end

absentItem.means: a list edit named an item not there

requiredAbsence.means: a `create` found the object already there; `root` names where

budgetExhausted.means: a chain of sends spent its ledger (`depth`, `work` or `storage`)

duplicateIdentity.means: the same intent with a different request: not a receipt; `original` is the first
